# sreagent_outbound_configs (Data Source)

Every outbound_config row, read-only. An escalation target: PagerDuty, Grafana, a webhook, Slack or an on-call schedule.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sreagent_outbound_configs" "all" {}

output "outbound_configs_count" {
  value = length(data.sreagent_outbound_configs.all.items)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The resource key the list was read from.
- `items` (Attributes List) The rows. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))
- `truncated` (Boolean) True when the API returned as many rows as its cap and may hold more.

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `api_key_set` (Boolean) Whether the platform holds a value for api_key.
- `base_url_host` (String) Scheme, host and a non-default port of the URL, never its path or query. Null when no URL is saved.
- `base_url_set` (Boolean) Whether the platform holds a value for base_url.
- `card_event_kinds` (List of String) Webhook targets only: which groups of card events this target receives, as the whole set. approvals (card.approval_requested and card.approval_decided) is the default and the only group a target hears until more are chosen; created, moved, assignees, comments, checklist, relations and closed add card.created, card.moved, card.assignees_changed, card.commented and card.comment_deleted, card.checklist_changed, the link and child events, and card.closed and card.reopened. Needs at least one while card_events is on. The order does not matter. A target receives only what happens after card_events or enabled was switched on, or its first kind other than approvals was chosen; adding a further kind does not move that moment. Refused for any other provider_type. Needs platform v0.522.0.
- `card_event_text` (Boolean) Webhook targets only: include comment bodies, checklist item text and notes and a won't-do reason in the card events sent here. Off by default: an event then carries ids, key, title, column and who acted, never text. Turn it on only when the receiver should hold that text. Refused for any other provider_type. Needs platform v0.522.0.
- `card_events` (Boolean) Webhook targets only: also send the organization's card approval events here. Refused for any other provider_type.
- `default_severity_mapping` (String) Platform severity to provider severity, as jsonencode({...}). Unset uses the built-in mapping.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the target receives pages.
- `id` (String) The row's identifier on the platform.
- `name` (String) Unique within the organization.
- `oncall_schedule_id` (String) The schedule for an on-call target.
- `priority` (Number) Order among targets.
- `provider_type` (String) Which system this target reaches.
- `routing_key_set` (Boolean) Whether the platform holds a value for routing_key.
- `rule_count` (Number) Escalation rules pointing at this target.
- `slack_channel` (String) The channel for a Slack target.
